description: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE object-class-name-1 ONLY (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2; GR22 d)2.) — the referenced object is of EXACTLY the named class, never a subclass. LIVE since kb/Work PB389 (a trailing ONLY was a raw COBOL0307 parse error before): the descriptor carries the flag and §2023:14.9.39.3 SR12 a)1. / b)1. / c)1. read it. ONLY is §2023:8.10 context-sensitive — a legal user word at every edition — so the shape is gated only by the USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE clause's own 2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 USAGE clause's general format (§1985:VI.5.14.2) is `[ USAGE IS ] { BINARY | COMPUTATIONAL | COMP | DISPLAY | INDEX | PACKED-DECIMAL }` and nothing else, its §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR3 naming the numeric usages it has: 'a USAGE clause specifying BINARY, COMPUTATIONAL, or PACKED-DECIMAL must be declared with a PICTURE character-string that describes a numeric item', with no OBJECT REFERENCE alternative; §2002:13.16.58.1 prints `OBJECT REFERENCE [ interface-name-1 | [ FACTORY OF ] ACTIVE-CLASS | [ FACTORY OF ] class-name-1 [ ONLY ] ]`, §2002:F.1 item 6 lists ACTIVE-CLASS, FACTORY and OBJECT-REFERENCE among 'The following reserved words have been added', and §2002:F.2 item 82 states the change: 'Object orientation. Support for object oriented programming has been added.' §2002:13.16.58.3 GR14d2 has the phrase's meaning: 'If the ONLY phrase is specified' the object is 'an instance object of the specified class' (GR14d2b) or its factory object, never a subclass's. §2014:13.18.60.1 prints the same format and §2014:13.18.60.3 GR21d2 the same rule, so 2014 = 2023.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. UORON.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS UORONC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 C1 USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE UORONC ONLY.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE UORONC "NEW" RETURNING C1.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM UORON.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. UORONC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS UORONC.
